## Definition check

The "Reproducibility" section is present in my instructions and reads as I would expect of the current rules. The sentence beginning "Repeatability must be", verbatim and in full:

> Repeatability must be measured on unchanged records under the same evaluator model and definition, because even a fixed or zero sampling temperature does not guarantee identical semantic judgements.

Proceeding was therefore appropriate. Note: the agent definition file itself is not on disk in this workspace (only `data/rubric/`, `input/`, `scripts/`, `src/download/prompts/` are present), so I recorded the supplied sha256 `9d08b5f3…` as `instrument_sha256` with `instrument_kind: agent_definition` rather than recomputing it.

## Result

**80 / 88 — fixed 90.9% (÷88), normalized 90.9% (÷88).** All 20 questions applicable; `excluded_max_points: 0`, `questions_not_applicable: 0`, so both bases coincide and `excluded_item_ids` is empty.

| Category | Score |
|---|---|
| Structural Completeness (Q1–5) | 16 / 21 |
| Metadata Quality & Content (Q6–10) | 20 / 21 |
| Technical Documentation (Q11–15) | 24 / 25 |
| FAIRness & Accessibility (Q16–20) | 20 / 21 |

Deductions: Q1 = 4 (12/14 fields; `resources`, `parent_datasets` empty), Q3 = 3 (four broad keywords), Q4 = 3 (three released formats; WAV not counted, as the record states raw audio is withheld from this release), Q8 = 4 (DPIA explicitly not conducted), Q15 = 4 (subgroups named, distributions never quantified), Q20 = 4 (correct `BiasTypeEnum` use but no AIO mappings, qualitative fairness only).

Applicability was resolved before scoring, using only fields outside each conditional question's own basis: human subjects from `description`/`keywords`/`collection_mechanisms`; sharing from `page`/`license_and_use_terms`; software output from the `external_resources` code repositories; collection from the populated acquisition fields. Each conditional item carries `applicability_status` and `applicability_evidence`.

Semantic analysis: 24 consistency checks passed, 2 failed, 10 warnings. The failures are the missing DPIA against a self-documented irreducible re-identification risk, and the governance contact sitting under `data_governance` rather than the `regulatory_restrictions.governance_committee_contact` path Q9 names (recorded, not deducted). Identifier validation was clean throughout — PhysioNet prefix `10.13026` agrees with the declared publisher, `OT2OD032720` parses as a Common-Fund-appropriate NIH Other Transaction award, `RRID:SCR_007345` is well-formed, and the ISCA and Zenodo prefixes match their claimed reference types. Two independent arithmetic checks corroborate the record: 306 + 136 + 391 = 833 matches `instances.counts`, and the STFT parameters are self-consistent (25 ms at 16 kHz = 400 samples = the stated FFT size; 201 bins = its non-redundant half-spectrum).

Output written to `output_evaluation.json` and validated with the exact command specified; it reported `VALID … rubric20-semantic` with exit status 0. No judgement was altered to satisfy serialization.
